current.text: Dallas is short on true ball handlers. The only real guards on the roster are Kyrie Irving, rookie Sergio de Larrea and Sasser.
Nick expects Sasser to get a chance at a bigger role in Dallas.
Josh does not have Sasser in his projected Dallas starting five: Kyrie Irving, Max Christie, Cooper Flagg, P.J. Washington and Morez Johnson Jr.
Yahoo lists him as questionable with a hip injury.
Dallas has a 4-4-4 schedule in our fantasy playoff weeks, but a league-high 16 back-to-backs.

durable.text: He can go on hot shooting streaks.
Josh thinks he is a bad NBA player.
His projected points, rebounds and steals are far below the top 250 pool.

note: Both Yahoo and ESPN value Sasser at 0 USD, and he ranks 395 on Yahoo and 316 on ESPN. That is far outside the 144 players our league drafts, so do not draft him. His projected 5.1 points, 1.0 rebounds and 0.4 steals give him little value in any build. Early in the season, check his hip and his minutes. Dallas has so few guards that a real role would make him a short-term waiver pickup for threes, and the 4-4-4 playoff schedule helps with that.
